# Workflow automation pilot metrics and scorecard

Wexpro Labs provides a transparent scorecard for evaluating a workflow automation pilot before increasing volume.

## Direct answer

Track cases received, eligible cases, verified completions, verified no-touch completions, exception-review minutes, runtime, and total measured run cost. Set quality, coverage, safety, labor, and cost thresholds before the pilot begins.

## Core formulas

- No-touch completion rate = verified no-touch completions divided by eligible cases.
- Team hours returned = (manual minutes per case multiplied by verified no-touch completions minus exception-review minutes) divided by 60.
- Cost per verified completion = total measured run cost divided by verified completions.

Runtime is elapsed system time, not labor saved. Excluded cases should remain visible beside failures and completions so a narrow eligible case set cannot inflate the reported result.

## Scale decision

Increase volume only after the pre-agreed quality, coverage, safety, labor, and cost thresholds hold for the chosen measurement window and every remaining exception has an explicit owner.
